title: 第907章 离开黑雾深渊第906章 我的朋友
content_zh:
与此同时，荒兽天帝也带着苏辰和洛雪儿离开沧溟天，冲出黑雾边境之后，朝上方的混沌迷雾而去。
除了他们三个之外，还有一头九阶后期的青蛇荒兽也跟在他们身后，实力相当于八级武圣的级别。
“这里便是太渊晦墟的边缘之处，混沌迷雾。”
荒兽天帝介绍道：“混沌迷雾的存在，就是为了将所有进入太渊晦墟的人类武者，都永远囚禁在这里，如果没有本帝许可，任何人类武者都不可能出得去。”
苏辰点了点头，他也明白此地的封锁是多么强烈。
来到混沌迷雾的正下方，荒兽天帝的步伐戛然而止，淡淡道：“青蛇，接下来就由你带着他们冲出混沌迷雾，送他们离开吧。”
“是！”
青蛇荒兽点了点头，毕恭毕敬道：“二位，跟我来吧。”
这也是他们来此路上便商量好的约定。
荒兽天帝留在太渊晦墟内部，只由青蛇荒兽，带着苏辰和洛雪儿冲出混沌迷雾，然后再将那最后三万枚帝玄晶带回来。
冲出混沌迷雾后，苏辰和洛雪儿便算是彻底离开了太渊晦墟，就算荒兽天帝到时候追杀出来，他们也可以躲进天机宝玉空间中，不必担心这家伙出尔反尔。
而如果苏辰想要霸占下最后那三万枚帝玄晶的话，凭青蛇荒兽八级武圣级别的实力，也可以拖住他一时，让荒兽天帝及时冲出来阻止。
这种各退一步的方法，算是同时杜绝了双方反悔的可能性。
青蛇荒兽释放出一团纯净的荒芜之气，化作一枚黑色光球，将苏辰和洛雪儿都笼罩其中，朝上方的混沌迷雾飘去。
荒兽天帝伫立在原地，望着苏辰的身影越来越远，淡然喝道：“小子，不要忘了，十年之后再会！”
苏辰低头看了荒兽天帝一眼，露出个意味深长的笑容：“放心吧，我们一定会再见的。”
在黑色光球的庇护下，他们两人在畅通无阻通过漫天斥力，直接穿梭过混沌迷雾。
望着周围的情景，重新变成了漫天黑雾的无尽深渊，洛雪儿心中无比激动。
对于天玄大陆所有武者来说，太渊晦墟都是有进无出的绝地，那么多高阶武圣，乃至武帝级别的强者，都被困死在这里成百上千年而无法逃脱。
但少爷仅仅只用一个多月的时间，便通过与荒兽天帝达成交易，带着她一起安然无恙地逃出生天。

这不仅是少爷的能力，更是上天对少爷的气运眷顾。
“开！”
青蛇荒兽目光一凝，指尖凝聚着一缕极为精纯的荒芜之气，信手一挥抛向半空。
黑色光点飞到半空后，在漫天滞重的滚滚黑雾中刺破一条小小的裂缝，继而化作一道漆黑的空间通道从天而降，入口处就位于他们面前。
content_en:
At the same time, the Desolate Beast Emperor also left Cangmingtian with Su Chen and Luo Xueer, rushed out of the black mist border, and headed towards the chaotic mist above.
In addition to the three of them, there was also a late-9th-level green snake desolate beast following behind them. Its strength was equivalent to that of an eighth-level Martial Saint.
"This is the edge of Taiyuan Huixu, in the mist of chaos."
The Desolate Beast Heavenly Emperor introduced: "The existence of the Chaos Mist is to imprison all human warriors who enter Taiyuan Huixu here forever. Without my permission, no human warrior can get out."
Su Chen nodded, he also understood how strong the blockade was here.
Arriving directly under the mist of chaos, the Desolate Beast Emperor stopped abruptly and said calmly: "Green Snake, it's up to you to lead them out of the mist of chaos and send them away."
"Yes!"
The Green Snake Desolate Beast nodded and said respectfully: "You two, come with me."
This was also an agreement they had made on their way here.
The Desolate Beast Heavenly Emperor stayed inside Taiyuan Huixu. Only the Green Snake Desolate Beast took Su Chen and Luo Xueer out of the fog of chaos, and then brought back the last 30,000 Emperor Xuan Crystals.
After breaking out of the mist of chaos, Su Chen and Luo Xueer had completely left Taiyuan Hui Ruins. Even if the Desolate Beast Emperor came out to hunt them down, they could hide in the Tianji Baoyu space without worrying about this guy going back on his word.
And if Su Chen wants to seize the last 30,000 Emperor Xuan Crystals, with the strength of the Green Snake Desolate Beast's eighth-level Martial Saint, he can hold him back for a while, allowing the Desolate Beast Heavenly Emperor to rush out and stop him in time.
This method of taking one step back simultaneously eliminates the possibility of both sides going back on their word.
The Green Snake Desolate Beast released a ball of pure desolate energy, turned into a black ball of light, enveloped Su Chen and Luo Xueer, and floated towards the chaotic mist above.
The Desolate Beast Emperor stood there, watching Su Chen's figure getting further and further away, and shouted calmly: "Boy, don't forget, see you again in ten years!"
Su Chen lowered his head and glanced at the Desolate Beast Emperor, showing a meaningful smile: "Don't worry, we will definitely meet again."
Under the protection of the black ball of light, the two of them passed through the repulsive force of the sky unimpeded and passed directly through the fog of chaos.
Looking at the surrounding scene, which once again turned into an endless abyss filled with black fog, Luo Xueer was extremely excited.
For all the warriors in Tianxuan Continent, Taiyuan Huixu is a desperate place with no way in or out. So many high-level martial saints and even strong men at the level of Martial Emperor have been trapped here for hundreds of thousands of years without being able to escape.
But in just over a month, the young master reached a deal with the Desolate Beast Emperor and escaped with her safe and sound.
This is not only the young master's ability, but also God's blessing on the young master.
"Open!"
The Green Snake Desolate Beast's eyes condensed, and a wisp of extremely pure desolate energy condensed on its fingertips, and it was thrown into the air with a wave of its hand.
After the black light point flew into the mid-air, it pierced a small crack in the billowing black fog that filled the sky, and then turned into a dark space channel and fell from the sky. The entrance was right in front of them.
